info.title: POH patient mobile API
info.description: Mobile team contract: OTP login, profile/session support and self-only in-person appointments with hospital approval. Direct registration is PLANNED and is not callable yet. Use the patient token from the chosen accounts[] entry, never staff credentials or service-account API keys. See docs/mobile-app-login.md and docs/mobile-appointments.md. No family booking, specialty, online payment or cancellation/reschedule APIs. Implemented OTP policy follows Care (10 sends/hour, 3 tries/code, 5 failures locks for 60 minutes); this differs from the KB prototype policy.

post.summary: Submit own in-person appointment for staff approval
post.description: Only request_id, slot_id and optional patient_notes are accepted. Patient is determined by access token. New submission holds one seat and returns 201 pending. An identical request_id+normalized payload replay returns 200 with the same booking’s latest status; changed payload returns 409. The receipt and booking commit atomically. No family, cancellation/reschedule request or online payment is provided.

200.description: Identical submission replay; current appointment state, no duplicate seat.

post.summary: Verify OTP and select a patient account
post.description: Each live patient on the verified phone receives a separate token pair/user in accounts[], oldest first. Keep account selection when multiple entries are returned. Currently unknown numbers return 404; is_new_user is always false and no registration_token is issued.

post.description: No bearer auth required. Save both new tokens. Previous refresh token has a 2-minute retry grace; reuse after grace revokes the session. Default refresh lifetime is 60 days.

401.description: Expired, revoked or wrong token type; sign in again.

post.description: Uses refresh token even when access expired. Always returns 200, including invalid tokens. Other profile sessions remain signed in.

NOT IMPLEMENTED. This URL currently returns framework 404, which may not use the mobile envelope. Draft fields below are for mobile UI planning only. Requires new OTP-proof branch, pre-login facility catalogue and backend atomic patient/account/PRE/session creation. Intended success data is Account; HTTP success/replay statuses and token expiry remain undecided. Existing patients continue OTP login. See mobile-appointments.md registration section. Do not use staff app/patients or ship a service-account key on the phone.
